* Overview

This file enumerates 89 of the 90 routable page types (plus one
auxiliary =subType= companion, 91 array entries total) recognised by
=ShowAllEntityData.user.js=, as declared in the =pageDefinitions= array
(=ShowAllEntityData.user.js:12073-14907= as of this sync — re-grep
=const pageDefinitions = [= rather than trust this range, it drifts
as the script grows) and gated by the
=// @include= regexes in the userscript header (five for MusicBrainz, four
for springsteenlyrics.com, one each for jungleland.it and brucespringsteen.it,
three for brucebase.wikidot.com). The one routable type without a row here is
=iswc= — pre-existing drift, noticed on 2026-10-04 while adding the
springsteenlyrics.com types (#87/#88, and #89/#90 on 2026-10-05), which with the
jungleland.it type (#91) and the brucespringsteen.it type (#92, both 2026-10-06),
the later springsteenlyrics.com types (#94/#95) and the Brucebase types (#96,
2026-10-07, and #97/#98, 2026-10-09) are the only ones not on MusicBrainz at all (see
docs/claude/springsteenlyrics.md, docs/claude/jungleland.md,
docs/claude/brucespringsteen.md and docs/claude/brucebase.md). For each page type it gives
a real, clickable MusicBrainz URL (using live MBIDs looked up via the
MusicBrainz web service), the script's =tableMode=, the button(s) that
trigger it, and a plain-language summary of which script features actually
fire (column extractors, injected columns, collapsible cells, CAA/EAA
artwork, sticky columns, etc.).

Wherever the page type is tied to a specific entity, the entity is
Bruce Springsteen or something directly connected to him (his catalogue,
Columbia Records, The Stone Pony, New Jersey, ...). A handful of page types
are inherently global/editor-scoped (reports, elections, tag lookup,
genres, CD stubs, ISRC lookup, user-owned collections) and use real but
not-Springsteen-specific MusicBrainz identifiers instead — noted inline.
Two entries (=collections-releases= and every =user-*= page type) need an
identifier that belongs to a specific editor/collection; the editor
username =vzell= is used throughout since it is a real, publicly viewable
MusicBrainz account, but a real collection MBID could not be found by
search and is left as a =<collection-mbid>= placeholder.

* Coverage clusters & representatives

Most of the page types above are structural near-duplicates of a
smaller number of shapes (same =tableMode=/feature pipeline, different
entity kind or column names). This section names those clusters, picks
1-2 representatives per cluster for the =tests/snapshots/= regression
harness (rather than one capture per type), and tracks capture status.
No new captures happened in this pass — see the =add-snapshot-pagetype=
skill for turning a =planned= row into a =captured= one.

** Identifier selection criteria

1. Default to Bruce Springsteen or a directly-connected entity — reuse an
   existing ~Identifier legend~ abbreviation before minting a new one.
   Only global/admin pages with no natural entity anchor (reports,
   elections, CD stubs, ISRC lookup, tag lookup) keep a non-Springsteen
   identifier, matching this doc's existing practice.
2. Prefer the smallest-catalog qualifying identifier (ideally a single
   native MB page) unless the representative's whole point is exercising
   pagination, in which case use the minimum page count that still
   triggers it — 2 native pages (see =RG_GREET='s existing use in
   =tests/live/release-group-paginated-fetch.spec.js= for the precedent).
3. Row count risk is NOT uniform across page shapes anchored on the same
   identifier: an aggregate/summary list (tags, aliases, ratings count)
   stays tiny regardless of how prolific the anchor entity is, but a
   per-item listing (releases, recordings, relationships) scales with the
   anchor's real catalog. =ARTIST= (Bruce Springsteen, 2000+ release
   groups) and =INSTR_GT= ("Guitar", used on presumably thousands of
   recordings) are both already in the legend for good reasons (they're
   real, well-documented Springsteen/generic-instrument identifiers) but
   are a poor fit for the *listing*-shaped representatives flagged below —
   pick a smaller substitute for those specific rows at capture time
   (a session musician, a specific instrument like "lap steel guitar",
   etc.), not for the aggregate-shaped rows that reuse the same
   abbreviation safely.

* Page type details
** 1. taglookup
- URL: [[https://musicbrainz.org/taglookup][/taglookup]]
- Match: ~path.includes('/taglookup')~
- Button: "Show all Releases for Tags"
- tableMode: single
- Features exercised:
  - Column extractors: Name → CAA sort-key; Country/Date split; Tracks summed into "Total Tracks"; Format expanded into Format Types
  - Synthetic column: Date → Day/Month/Year parts
  - Injected "Relationships" column
  - Multi-row rendering + collapsible toggles on Label, Catalog#, Country/Date, CAA
  - CAA thumbnails next to Name; Name is the sticky/main column
  - =insertH2: 'Releases'=, =insertPrependH2: 'Searchform'=

** 2. cdtoc
- URL: [[https://musicbrainz.org/cdtoc][/cdtoc]]
- Match: ~path.includes('/cdtoc')~
- Button: "Show all CDToc attached to Releases"
- tableMode: single
- Features exercised:
  - Country/Date split, Date → D/M/Y synthetic columns
  - Injected "Relationships" column
  - Multi-row + collapsible on Label, Catalog#
  - CAA thumbnails next to Title; Title is sticky/main column

** 3. artist-credit-entity
- URL: [[https://musicbrainz.org/artist-credit/2035305/release-groups][/artist-credit/AC_ID/release-groups]]
- Match: ~/\/artist-credit\/[^/]+\/.+/~ (must precede the plain =artist-credit= entry)
- Button: "Show all Artist-Credit Entities"
- tableMode: single
- Features exercised: converts the page's native list to a table (=listToTable=); separate column sets per entity kind for Release groups / Releases / Recordings sub-views

** 4. artist-credit
- URL: [[https://musicbrainz.org/artist-credit/2035305][/artist-credit/AC_ID]]
- Match: ~/\/artist-credit\//~
- Button: "Show all Artist-Credit Uses"
- tableMode: multi
- Features exercised: =insertH2: 'Artist list'=, =listToTable=, per-entity-kind (Release groups/Releases/Recordings) column sets

** 5. user-subscriptions
- URL: [[https://musicbrainz.org/user/vzell/subscriptions][/user/USER/subscriptions]]
- Match: ~/\/user\/.*\/subscriptions/~
- Buttons (rewrite the last path segment, not a query param): "🧮 Artist subscriptions" → =/user/USER/artist=; "🧮 Collection subscriptions" → =/collection=; "🧮 Label subscriptions" → =/label=; "🧮 Series subscriptions" → =/series=; "🧮 Editor subscriptions" → =/editor=
- tableMode: single
- Features exercised: sticky/main column = Name

** 6. editor-subscribers
- URL: [[https://musicbrainz.org/user/vzell/subscribers][/user/USER/subscribers]]
- Match: ~/^\/user\/[^/]+\/subscribers\/?$/~ (anchored since the entity subscribers pages, #124–#127)
- Button: "Show all Editor Subscribers for User"
- tableMode: single
- Features exercised: =listToTable=, =foldAnonymousSubscribers=, =showIf: _hasH2List=

** 7. account-applications
- URL: [[https://musicbrainz.org/account/applications][/account/applications]]
- Match: ~/\/account\/applications/~
- Button: "Show all Applications"
- tableMode: multi, non_paginated
- Features exercised: =groupByH3= (rows grouped per section heading)

** 8-18. Entity =*-tags= pages (identical shape, 11 entity kinds)


All eleven share: =showAllTags: true=, =removeSelector: 'div.all-tags'=,
=renameH2ToH3: true= (native =<h2>= demoted so the page-level toolbar has
its own heading), =listToTable: ['genres','tags']= (native =<ul>= genre/tag
lists converted into sortable tables), tableMode =multi=.

** 143. ia-search
- URL: [[https://archive.org/search?query=subject%3A%22Bruce+Springsteen%22&sort=title&and%5B%5D=year%3A%221975%22][archive.org/search?query=subject:"Bruce Springsteen" (year 1975)]] (2026-10-31, org/internet.archive.org; mockup https://claude.ai/artifact/4aXkdPxudwhuzACj4Wg81C).
- Match: =_IA_SEARCH_PATH_RE= on =_isIaHost= (archive.org or www., never web.archive.org); its =@include= line needs a non-empty =query=. The page is a Lit web-component shell (=<body>= holds only =<app-root>=, no rows in its HTML; its Tile and Compact list views are one document): our =#mb-ia-root= goes first in =<body>= (=_iaPrepareLivePage()=).
- Buttons: "Show all items" (hidden without a query, and for a full-text search, =sin=TXT= / TV / RADIO, which the API does not index: =_iaSearchUsable()=).
- Rows: =advancedsearch.php= with the page's =query=, =and[]= and =not[]= as one Solr query (=_iaSearchSolr()=), =sort[]=date asc= then title (vzell's answer Q4), 100 a page, at most 100 pages; page 1 asked once for the count and kept (=_iaTexts=). Columns =_IA_HEADERS=; an item with several dates shows its earliest (the order's).

Unchecked by fixtures: whether archive.org's app leaves our section (before =<app-root>=) alone, and whether MusicBrainz's =frame-src= allows archive.org's player — live checks.

** Relationship-tables buttons on existing pageTypes (not pageTypes of their own)
=_relTablesButton()= adds a second button to series-releases, work-recordings, releasegroup-releases, recording-releases (with "Related works" as "Via <work>" tables), label-relationships and artist-relationships ("Relationship lists"), and release-tracks ("Credits", the release's own =#release-relationships= and its group's =#release-group-relationships=, never the per-medium track credits). Each runs as its own pageType for that render (=series-relationship-tables=, =work-relationship-tables=, =releasegroup-relationship-tables=, =recording-relationship-tables=, =label-relationship-tables=, =artist-relationship-tables=, =release-credit-tables=; =buttonConfig.type= switches =pageType= in =startFetchingProcess()=), with only its own features (=replaceFeatures=), and removes the page's main data section (=removeMain=, =_relRemoveMainSections()=). A saved file records that pageType and loads back as the same button (=_activateButtonForSavedPageType()=). Hidden with =sa_enable_relationship_tables= off (=showIf=). Coverage: =tests/fixtures/rel-tables-recording.spec.js= (incl. the main button unchanged and a Save → Load round trip) and =rel-tables-pages.spec.js=, raw captures =tests/fixtures/rel-{series,work,label-rels,artist-rels,release-group,recording,release}-overview.html=.

* Not independently routable

The =pageDefinitions= array also contains one auxiliary object with only a
=subType: 'artist-releasegroups'= key (no =type=) — see the note under
[[*77. artist-releasegroups][#77 artist-releasegroups]] above. It is not a
separate page type; it just drives a pre-fetch pass for that page type's
"Official" release-group counts and has no URL of its own.
